newsitem.title: INDIA: India, Seychelles sign tourism agreement.
newsitem.headline: India, Seychelles sign tourism agreement.

text.p: India and the Seychelles signed a bilateral agreement on Thursday to promote tourism aimed at increasing their share in the tourist traffic inflow to southern Asia.
The agreement covers exchange of information and cooperation among travel agents, tour operators, hotel agents, airlines and other organisations in the leisure sector.
Indian tourism minister Srikanta Kumar Jena and his Seychelles counterpart Simone de Commarmond signed the agreement which will be initially valid for five years and can be revived thereafter.
"This (agreement) will help in terms of attracting more tourists to both countries," the statement said.
